review: Yet another Sinking Ishmael ID but this time she uses Poise and speed as an extra mechanic. The problem? She is pretty much competing against Molar Ishmael in the sinking slot. Edgar Family Butler Ishmael skills roll up to 11 on S1, 14 on S2, and 13 on S3, with fulfilled conditions she goes to 13/16/16 which is, at best, average. With her speed range of 4-6, it’s not that hard to fulfill the Coin Power conditionals on her skills and she also has ways to manipulate it being haste and bind. Now her main purpose is to inflict sinking and other debuffs onto enemies, and her passive even helps her with it.
